data.message: All 49 fellow fishers: will you commit to 18 tons each? I commit if we all agree. That's $18,000 each—$8,000 more than 10. Total catch 900 leaves 100: next stock is 1,000 with 75% probability, or 200 with 25%. Unlike 10 each, recovery isn't assured; we'd need lower catches after a poor recovery. Requests above the plan could also risk collapse if fewer than 50 remain. Commitments are voluntary, not enforced. Please explicitly pledge 18 or state your concerns.
